title: Bilanz der polizeilichen Maßnahmen zum Jahreswechsel 2025/2026

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin police summarized the New Year's Eve 2025/2026 deployment: about 800 investigations, around 430 arrests, and 35 officers injured, 22 by pyrotechnics. Numerous attacks on emergency workers and 47 vehicle fires were also reported citywide.
